The support inventory establishes exactness conditional on the proposed RAM recognition within its predicted region. All observed eye origins lie inside the ROI and away from horizontal wrap. Physical wrap behavior is covered by a synthetic witness, not these 221 real samples; vertical clipping and complete occlusion likewise are not established by this real sample.
